# Often Enough

> A simple habit tracker for Android and iPhone. Start free, and pay once if you ever want more. No subscription, no account and no ads.

Often Enough tracks habits you check off, count, time, tick step by step, or want to quit or cut down, and one-time or repeating tasks. Habits stay on the phone and in the person's own Google Drive or iCloud, never on a server of ours.

- Free: 5 habits, unlimited tasks, reminders and full-screen alarms, routines, streaks, progress views, One habit and Tasks widgets, backup to your own cloud, and export.
- Plus, one payment and no subscription: unlimited habits, list widgets (Today, a time of day, Quit or cut down) and the This week widget, Year in Pixels, new checklist habits, and Remind me again.
- Phones only: an Android app and an iPhone app. There are no tablet, watch or desktop apps.

- [Privacy policy](https://oftenenough.com/privacy): what's stored, where, and who can see it
- [Terms of use](https://oftenenough.com/terms): the terms for the app and for Plus
